QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Word Around the Saloon
QuestInfo.0: While Hawkeye processes the materials he has, you can speak with the #bSeekers#k in Hotel Arcus about Tallahart. Why not start with #bBlanc#k?
QuestInfo.1: Blanc confirms what Carlisle suggested, that Tallahart is nothing but desolate ruins. Talk to #bRusty#k now.
QuestInfo.2: Rusty also didn't have any information on Tallahart. He said maybe the ancient god #bArchelon#k might know something... Oh, right. Is Archelon even okay? Better check on him.
